zh: 你能帮我看一下这个吗？
en: Could you have a look at this for me?
alt: Can you take a look at this for me?
point: “帮我看一下”不说 help me see，用 Could you have a look… for me

zh: 我可以早点走吗？
en: Is it OK if I head off early?
alt: Do you mind if I leave a bit early?
Would it be OK if I left early?
point: 请求许可用 Is it OK if I…，别说 Can I early go

zh: 要不要我帮你重启一下？
en: Do you want me to restart it for you?
alt: Shall I restart it for you?
Want me to restart it?
point: 主动帮忙用 Do you want me to…，不是 Do you need I…

zh: 麻烦把链接发我一下。
en: Could you send me the link?
alt: Would you mind sending me the link?
point: “麻烦…一下”不是 trouble，用 Could you… 就够礼貌

zh: 我们要一个靠窗的位子，可以吗？
en: Could we get a table by the window?
alt: Is it possible to have a table by the window?
point: 订座别说 We want…，用 Could we get…

zh: 请给我拿杯水。
en: Could I get a glass of water, please?
alt: Can I have some water, please?
point: “给我”不是 give me，点东西说 Could I get…, please?

zh: 我们周六去打网球吧。
en: Shall we play tennis on Saturday?
alt: How about tennis on Saturday?
Let's play tennis on Saturday.
point: 句尾“…吧”是提建议：Shall we… / How about…

zh: 你介意我加入吗？
en: Mind if I join in?
alt: Do you mind if I join you?
point: 口语可省成 Mind if I…？加入正在进行的活动用 join in

zh: 能便宜一点吗？
en: Could you do it any cheaper?
alt: Is there any chance of a discount?
Could you do a better price?
point: “便宜一点”不说 cheap a little，用 do it any cheaper

zh: 我可以试穿一下吗？
en: Can I try this on?
alt: Is it OK if I try this on?
point: “试穿”是 try on，代词夹中间：try this on

zh: 你能帮我们拍张照吗？
en: Would you mind taking a photo of us?
alt: Could you take a photo of us?
point: Would you mind 后面接 -ing，不接 to do

zh: 我可以把座位往后调吗？
en: Do you mind if I put my seat back?
alt: Is it OK if I recline my seat?
point: 征求别人同意：Do you mind if I…；“往后调”是 put back

zh: 你最好去看看医生。
en: You should probably see a doctor.
alt: I'd see a doctor if I were you.
Maybe you should see a GP.
point: “最好”别直译 you'd better（语气像警告），用 should probably

zh: 能帮我约个周五的号吗？
en: Could you book me in for Friday?
alt: Could I make an appointment for Friday?
point: “帮我约”不说 help me book，用 book me in

zh: 你能把音乐关小一点吗？
en: Could you turn the music down a bit?
alt: Would you mind turning the music down?
point: “关小”是 turn down，不是 close small

zh: 要我帮你拿吗？
en: Do you want a hand with that?
alt: Shall I carry that for you?
Want me to grab that?
point: 主动帮忙常说 Do you want a hand？不必直译“拿”

zh: 我们改天一起喝杯咖啡吧。
en: We should grab a coffee sometime.
alt: Let's catch up for a coffee sometime.
point: “改天…吧”常说 We should… sometime，不是 another day

zh: 不用了，谢谢。
en: I'm good, thanks.
alt: No thanks, I'm all good.
I'm fine, thanks.
point: 婉拒别说 No need，用 I'm good, thanks

zh: 可以刷卡吗？
en: Can I pay by card?
alt: Do you take card?
Is card OK?
point: “刷卡”不是 brush card，说 pay by card

zh: 你能借我二十块吗？
en: Could you lend me twenty bucks?
alt: Any chance I could borrow twenty dollars?
point: 别人借给我用 lend me；我向别人借用 borrow

zh: 会议能不能改到明天？我今天实在忙不过来。
en: Would you mind if we moved the meeting to tomorrow? I'm swamped today.
alt: Could we push the meeting to tomorrow? I'm flat out today.
point: Would you mind if we + 过去式，比现在时更委婉

zh: 如果你有空的话，能帮我看一下这份报告吗？
en: If you've got a minute, could you look over this report for me?
alt: When you get a chance, could you have a look at this report?
point: “有空的话”说 if you've got a minute，不说 if you have free

zh: 我建议先备份数据再升级系统。
en: I'd suggest backing up the data before you upgrade the system.
alt: I'd recommend taking a backup before upgrading the system.
point: suggest 后接 -ing，不说 suggest you to do

zh: 你能不能把屏幕共享一下，这样大家都能看到？
en: Could you share your screen so everyone can see it?
alt: Would you mind sharing your screen so we can all see?
point: “把屏幕共享”是 share your screen；目的用 so 连接

zh: 不好意思，酱汁能不能放旁边？我对乳制品过敏。
en: Sorry, could I have the sauce on the side? I'm allergic to dairy.
alt: Excuse me, can I get the sauce on the side? I'm allergic to dairy.
point: “放旁边”是 on the side；开口先说 Sorry / Excuse me

zh: 我们可以分开付吗？每个人付自己的。
en: Would it be possible to split the bill? We'll each pay for our own.
alt: Could we pay separately? We'll each get our own.
point: “分开付”是 split the bill；Would it be possible to… 很客气

zh: 你要是周日有空，要不要跟我们一起去跑步？
en: If you're free on Sunday, do you want to come for a run with us?
alt: Fancy joining us for a run on Sunday?
point: 邀请用 do you want to come…；“去跑步”是 go for a run

zh: 你能不能教我怎么发球？我总是发不好。
en: Could you show me how to serve? I keep messing it up.
alt: Would you mind showing me how to serve? I keep getting it wrong.
point: “教我怎么做”常说 show me how to；“总是”做错用 keep doing

zh: 能不能帮我把这个包起来？是送人的。
en: Could you gift-wrap this for me? It's a present.
alt: Would you mind wrapping this? It's a gift.
point: “送人的”说 It's a present，不是 send people

zh: 这个我能退吗？我还留着小票。
en: Could I return this? I've still got the receipt.
alt: Is it possible to get a refund on this? I've kept the receipt.
point: “退货”用 return / get a refund；“小票”是 receipt

zh: 你能告诉我去机场的大巴在哪儿坐吗？
en: Could you tell me where to catch the airport bus?
alt: Could you tell me where I can get the bus to the airport?
point: Could you tell me 后用陈述语序：where I can…，不用 where can I

zh: 我们要不要早点出发，免得堵车？
en: Shall we leave a bit earlier to beat the traffic?
alt: How about leaving earlier so we miss the traffic?
point: “免得堵车”说 to beat the traffic，不说 avoid traffic jam happen

zh: 你要是不舒服，今天就在家休息吧，别硬撑。
en: If you're not feeling well, just take the day off. Don't push yourself.
alt: If you're feeling crook, just stay home today. No need to soldier on.
point: “硬撑”说 push yourself / soldier on；祈使句加 just 更柔和

zh: 我能不能下周一再回来复查？
en: Would it be OK to come back for a check-up next Monday?
alt: Could I come back for a follow-up next Monday?
point: Would it be OK to… 很客气；“复查”是 check-up / follow-up

zh: 你出门的时候能顺便把垃圾拿出去吗？
en: Could you take the rubbish out on your way out?
alt: Can you put the bins out when you leave?
point: “顺便”常用 on your way out；垃圾在新西兰叫 rubbish

zh: 我来洗碗吧，饭都是你做的。
en: Let me do the dishes, you did all the cooking.
alt: I'll wash up, since you cooked.
point: 主动提议用 Let me… / I'll…；“洗碗”是 do the dishes

zh: 周五我们几个去喝一杯，你要不要一起来？
en: A few of us are going for a drink on Friday. Want to come along?
alt: A few of us are heading out for drinks on Friday. Do you want to join us?
point: 随口邀请说 Want to come along?，别说 Do you want together come

zh: 谢谢邀请，不过这周末我可能去不了。
en: Thanks for the invite, but I don't think I can make it this weekend.
alt: Thanks for asking, but I probably can't make it this weekend.
point: 婉拒用 I don't think I can make it；“去不了”是 can't make it

zh: 这个月的房租我能不能晚几天交？
en: Would it be OK if I paid the rent a few days late this month?
alt: Is there any chance I could pay the rent a few days late this month?
point: Would it be OK if I + 过去式，委婉请求延期

zh: 你可以开个储蓄账户，每个月存一点。
en: You might want to open a savings account and put a bit away each month.
alt: It might be a good idea to open a savings account and save a bit every month.
point: You might want to… 是委婉建议；“存一点”说 put a bit away

zh: 我想问一下，下周的季度会议能不能改到周四下午？周三有几个人不在。
en: I was wondering if we could move next week's quarterly meeting to Thursday afternoon, since a few people are away on Wednesday.
alt: Would it be possible to shift next week's quarterly meeting to Thursday afternoon? A few people are away on Wednesday.
point: “我想问一下能不能”用 I was wondering if we could…，比 Can we 委婉

zh: 如果方便的话，麻烦你周五之前把预算表发给我，我好跟老板汇报。
en: If it's not too much trouble, could you send me the budget spreadsheet by Friday so I can update the boss?
alt: Would you be able to get the budget to me by Friday so I can brief my manager?
point: “麻烦你”说 if it's not too much trouble；“汇报”可说 update / brief

zh: 我建议我们先在测试环境里跑一遍，确认没问题了再上线。
en: I'd suggest we run it in the test environment first and only push it live once we're sure it's fine.
alt: I'd recommend testing it in staging first, then going live once we know it works.
point: I'd suggest we + 动词原形；“上线”是 go live / push live

zh: 你介不介意帮我看看这个报错？我折腾了一上午了，还是没搞明白。
en: Would you mind taking a look at this error? I've been going round in circles all morning and still can't work it out.
alt: Could you have a look at this error for me? I've been stuck on it all morning and I still can't figure it out.
point: “折腾半天”说 go round in circles；“搞明白”是 work it out

zh: 我们大概有十二个人，能不能订一个包间？最好七点左右。
en: There'll be about twelve of us. Would it be possible to book a private room, ideally around seven?
alt: We're a group of about twelve. Could we book a private room for around seven?
point: “我们有十二个人”说 There'll be twelve of us；“最好”用 ideally

zh: 不好意思，这块牛排对我来说有点太生了，能不能麻烦再煎一下？
en: Sorry to be a pain, but the steak's a bit too rare for me. Could you pop it back on the grill?
alt: Sorry, the steak's a little underdone for me. Would you mind cooking it a bit longer?
point: 提意见前先软化：Sorry to be a pain；“再煎一下”说 pop it back on

zh: 周六的比赛我们少一个人，你能不能来替补一下？只打半场也行。
en: We're short a player for Saturday's game. Any chance you could fill in, even if it's just for one half?
alt: We're a player down for Saturday. Could you fill in for us, even just for half the game?
point: Any chance you could… 是很口语的请求；“替补”说 fill in

zh: 你膝盖还没好，这周的训练我觉得你还是先别参加了，免得伤得更重。
en: Your knee's still not right, so I'd sit out this week's training if I were you, just so you don't make it worse.
alt: Your knee hasn't healed yet. Maybe give training a miss this week so you don't make it worse.
point: 委婉劝告用 I'd… if I were you；“不参加”说 sit out

zh: 这款沙发如果我下单的话，你们能不能送货上门，顺便把旧的拉走？
en: If I order this couch, would you be able to deliver it and take the old one away at the same time?
alt: If I buy this sofa, could you deliver it and take my old one away while you're there?
point: would you be able to 比 can you 客气；“拉走”说 take away

zh: 这件外套我挺喜欢的，就是有点贵，我再考虑一下，先不买了，谢谢。
en: I really like this jacket, but it's a bit out of my price range, so I'll have a think about it. Thanks anyway.
alt: I love this jacket, but it's a bit pricey for me. I'll have a think and maybe come back. Thanks.
point: 婉拒店员说 I'll have a think；“有点贵”说 out of my price range

zh: 请问能不能帮我把航班改到明天早上？今天这班我实在赶不上了。
en: Is there any way you could change my flight to tomorrow morning? There's no way I'll make today's one.
alt: Would it be possible to move me onto a flight tomorrow morning? I'm not going to make today's.
point: Is there any way you could… 用于麻烦人的请求；“赶不上”是 won't make it

zh: 要不我们先把行李寄存在酒店，去市中心逛逛，下午回来再办入住？
en: How about we leave our bags at the hotel, have a wander around the city centre, and check in when we get back this afternoon?
alt: Why don't we drop our bags at the hotel, explore the city centre, and check in later this afternoon?
point: How about we + 动词原形；“逛逛”说 have a wander；centre 英式拼写

zh: 医生，我最近老是睡不好，您看要不要做个检查，还是先调整一下作息？
en: I've been sleeping really badly lately. Do you think I should get some tests done, or just try changing my routine first?
alt: I haven't been sleeping well lately. Would you recommend some tests, or should I try adjusting my routine first?
point: 征求建议用 Do you think I should…；“作息”说 routine

zh: 你最近压力太大了，要不考虑休几天假，好好放松一下？身体最重要。
en: You've been under a lot of pressure lately. Have you thought about taking a few days off to recharge? Your health comes first.
alt: You've been really stressed lately. Maybe take a few days off and recharge? Your health's the most important thing.
point: Have you thought about + -ing 是很软的建议

zh: 不好意思打扰一下，你们家的狗晚上一直叫，能不能想想办法让它安静点？
en: Sorry to bother you, but your dog's been barking a lot at night. Is there anything you could do to keep it quiet?
alt: Sorry to bother you, but your dog's been barking at night. Would you be able to do something about it?
point: 提意见先说 Sorry to bother you，再用 Is there anything you could do

zh: 这个月我们轮流做饭怎么样？这样大家都轻松一点，你觉得呢？
en: What if we took turns cooking this month? It'd make things easier for everyone. What do you reckon?
alt: How about we take turns cooking this month? It'd be easier for all of us. What do you think?
point: What if we + 过去式 提建议；“你觉得呢”Kiwi 常说 What do you reckon?

zh: 下周六我们在家搞烧烤，你有空就过来吧，带上你女朋友也行。
en: We're having a barbie at ours next Saturday. Come along if you're free, and feel free to bring your girlfriend.
alt: We're doing a BBQ at our place next Saturday. Pop over if you're free, and you're welcome to bring your girlfriend.
point: 邀请说 Come along if you're free；“…也行”用 feel free to

zh: 真不好意思，那天我已经有安排了，要不我们改到下个周末？
en: I'm really sorry, but I've already got something on that day. Could we do the following weekend instead?
alt: Sorry, I've already got plans that day. How about the weekend after instead?
point: 婉拒加替代方案：I've got something on…, could we… instead?

zh: 这笔费用能不能分几个月付？一次性付清我现在有点吃力。
en: Is it possible to spread the cost over a few months? Paying it all up front would be a bit of a stretch for me right now.
alt: Could I pay this off in instalments? Paying it all at once would be tough for me at the moment.
point: “分期付”说 spread the cost / pay in instalments；“吃力”说 a stretch

zh: 你要是想省钱，可以考虑换一家电力公司，我换了以后每个月省了五十多块。
en: If you're trying to save money, it might be worth switching power companies. I saved over fifty bucks a month when I switched.
alt: If you want to cut costs, you could look at changing your power company. I've been saving more than fifty dollars a month since I switched.
point: 委婉建议说 it might be worth + -ing；“换公司”说 switch

zh: 我们休息五分钟吧。
en: Shall we take a five-minute break?
alt: How about a quick five-minute break?
point: “…吧”提议休息：Shall we take a break，别说 rest five minutes

zh: 能帮我连一下Wi-Fi吗？
en: Could you help me get onto the Wi-Fi?
alt: Can you help me connect to the Wi-Fi?
point: “连Wi-Fi”说 get onto / connect to the Wi-Fi，不是 link

zh: 能帮我开一下门吗？
en: Could you get the door for me?
alt: Can you open the door for me?
point: 手里拿着东西请人开门，常说 get the door

zh: 这件有大一号的吗？能帮我拿一件吗？
en: Could I get this in a size up?
alt: Have you got this in a bigger size?
point: “大一号”说 a size up，请店员拿用 Could I get…

zh: 我们还没想好，能再等一下吗？
en: Could we have a few more minutes?
alt: We're still deciding. Could you give us a minute?
point: 还没选好菜，说 Could we have a few more minutes，不说 wait a little

zh: 能帮我把这张五十的换成零钱吗？
en: Could you break this fifty for me?
alt: Could I get change for a fifty?
point: “换零钱”说 break a note 或 get change，不说 change small money

zh: 你坐下歇会儿吧。
en: Why don't you sit down for a bit?
alt: Maybe have a sit-down for a bit.
point: Why don't you… 是劝人做某事，不是问原因

zh: 能帮我看一下行李吗？
en: Could you keep an eye on my bag?
alt: Would you mind watching my bag for a sec?
point: “帮我看着”是 keep an eye on，不是 look my bag

zh: 你能帮我计一下这圈的时间吗？
en: Could you time me on this lap?
alt: Can you time my lap?
point: “给我计时”直接用动词 time me，不用 count the time

zh: 要不要我开车送你回家？
en: Do you want a lift home?
alt: Shall I drive you home?
point: 开车“送你回家”说 a lift home，不是 send you home

zh: 请问您愿意做我的推荐人吗？
en: Would you be happy to be one of my referees?
alt: Would you be willing to be a referee for me?
point: 求职推荐人在新西兰叫 referee；Would you be happy to… 很客气

zh: 你能帮我看看简历吗？
en: Would you mind checking my CV?
alt: Could you have a look at my CV?
point: Would you mind 后接 -ing；“简历”在新西兰一般说 CV

zh: 面试能改到下午吗？
en: Could we do the interview in the afternoon instead?
alt: Would it be possible to move the interview to the afternoon?
point: 改时间用 Could we do… instead，不说 change to afternoon

zh: 老师，您能说慢一点吗？
en: Could you speak a bit more slowly?
alt: Would you mind speaking a little more slowly?
point: “慢一点”是 a bit more slowly，不是 slowly a little

zh: 我拍一下你的笔记可以吗？
en: Is it OK if I take a photo of your notes?
alt: Do you mind if I snap a photo of your notes?
point: Is it OK if I + 陈述句；“拍照”说 take a photo of

zh: 我们一起复习吧。
en: Why don't we study together?
alt: Shall we revise together?
point: 提议“一起…吧”用 Why don't we…；复习考试可说 revise

zh: 我下周能来看房吗？
en: Could I come and view the flat next week?
alt: Would it be possible to see the flat next week?
point: “看房”说 view the flat，come and + 动词很口语

zh: 押金能分两次付吗？
en: Could I pay the bond in two lots?
alt: Is it OK if I pay the bond in two parts?
point: 租房“押金”是 bond，不是 deposit money；“分两次”说 in two lots

zh: 我们排个打扫值日表吧。
en: Shall we set up a cleaning roster?
alt: How about we do a cleaning roster?
point: “值日表”说 roster；和室友提议用 Shall we…

zh: 你能把车往前挪一点吗？
en: Could you move your car up a bit?
alt: Would you mind moving your car forward a bit?
point: “往前挪”说 move up a bit，不是 move front

zh: 我们不在家这几天，能帮忙收一下信吗？
en: Would you mind clearing our letterbox?
alt: Could you grab our mail for us?
point: “收信”说 clear the letterbox，不是 receive letters

zh: 要不要来我家喝杯茶？
en: Would you like to pop over for a cuppa?
alt: Do you want to come over for a cup of tea?
point: 邀请用 Would you like to；“过来坐坐”说 pop over，cuppa 指一杯茶

zh: 能跟我一起过一下这个月的账单吗？
en: Could you go through this month's bill with me?
alt: Could you walk me through this month's bill?
point: “一起看一遍”说 go through… with me 或 walk me through

zh: 我想升级一下宽带套餐。
en: I'd like to upgrade my broadband plan.
alt: I'm looking to upgrade my broadband plan.
point: 打电话提要求用 I'd like to，比 I want 礼貌

zh: 请问能派人来看一下吗？
en: Could you send someone out to have a look?
alt: Is it possible to get a technician out?
point: “派人上门”说 send someone out，不是 send a person come

zh: 能先给我报个价吗？
en: Could you give me a quote first?
alt: Can I get a quote before you start?
point: “报价”是 quote，不是 price report

zh: 你明天方便过来吗？
en: Would tomorrow suit you?
alt: Would tomorrow work for you?
point: 约时间问 Would tomorrow suit you? 比 Can you come 更客气

zh: 要我帮你扶着梯子吗？
en: Shall I hold the ladder for you?
alt: Do you want me to hold the ladder?
point: 主动帮忙用 Shall I…；“扶着”就是 hold

zh: 能再给我一张表吗？
en: Could I get another copy of the form?
alt: Could I have another form, please?
point: “一张表”说 a copy of the form，form 不是 table

zh: 您能告诉我下一步该怎么办吗？
en: Could you tell me what I need to do next?
alt: Could you tell me what the next step is?
point: Could you tell me 后用陈述语序：what I need to do

zh: 材料我明天再交过来可以吗？
en: Can I bring the documents in tomorrow?
alt: Is it OK if I drop the paperwork in tomorrow?
point: “交过来”说 bring in / drop in，不是 hand over come

zh: 谁能帮忙叫一下救护车？
en: Can someone call an ambulance, please?
alt: Could somebody ring an ambulance?
point: 急事也可用 Can someone… please；“叫救护车”是 call an ambulance

zh: 要不要我帮你报警？
en: Do you want me to call the police?
alt: Shall I ring the police for you?
point: 主动帮忙用 Do you want me to…；“报警”是 call the police

zh: 我能用一下你的手机吗？急事。
en: Could I use your phone? It's urgent.
alt: Can I borrow your phone for a minute? It's an emergency.
point: 借手机打电话常说 use your phone；“急事”是 It's urgent

zh: 你能顺路载我一程吗？
en: Could you give me a lift?
alt: Any chance of a lift?
point: “载一程”是 give me a lift，Kiwi 很少说 ride

zh: 你开慢一点好吗？
en: Could you slow down a bit, please?
alt: Would you mind slowing down a little?
point: “开慢点”就说 slow down，不是 drive slow point

zh: 我们在这儿加个油吧。
en: Shall we stop for petrol here?
alt: Let's fill up here.
point: “加油”说 stop for petrol / fill up，不是 add oil

zh: 你要不要涂点防晒霜？
en: Do you want some sunscreen?
alt: Would you like some sunblock?
point: 递东西问 Do you want some…？“防晒霜”是 sunscreen

zh: 我们去海边走走吧。
en: Let's go for a walk on the beach.
alt: Shall we go for a beach walk?
point: “去走走”说 go for a walk，Let's 是最直接的提议

zh: 要不今天就别去徒步了。
en: Maybe we should skip the tramp today.
alt: Maybe we should give the tramp a miss today.
point: 委婉建议用 Maybe we should；新西兰徒步叫 tramp

zh: 你能帮我占个座吗？
en: Could you save me a seat?
alt: Can you keep a seat for me?
point: “占座”是 save me a seat，不是 occupy a seat

zh: 想不想去看场电影？
en: Fancy seeing a movie?
alt: Do you want to go and see a film?
point: Fancy + -ing 是口语邀请，比 Do you want 更随意

zh: 稍微修一下就行，谢谢。
en: Just a trim, please.
alt: Just a tidy-up, thanks.
point: 理发“修一下”说 a trim，不说 cut a little

zh: 你也在Sarah的贺卡上签个名吧？
en: Would you like to sign Sarah's card?
alt: Do you want to sign Sarah's card?
point: Would you like to 是礼貌邀请，不只是“你想不想要”

zh: 需要我带点什么吗？
en: Can I bring anything?
alt: Is there anything I can bring?
point: 去聚会前客气问 Can I bring anything?，不说 What should I take

zh: 我们一起凑钱给她买个礼物吧。
en: Shall we all chip in for a present?
alt: How about we all chip in for a gift?
point: “大家凑钱”说 chip in，不是 collect money together

zh: 你今天能帮我接一下孩子吗？
en: Could you pick the kids up for me today?
alt: Can you collect the kids for me today?
point: “接孩子”是 pick up，不是 receive；代词宾语放中间

zh: 宝贝，把玩具收一下好吗？
en: Can you pack your toys away, please?
alt: Could you tidy up your toys, please?
point: 对孩子也用 Can you… please；“收起来”是 pack away

zh: 妈，您在这儿多住几天吧。
en: Mum, why don't you stay a few more days?
alt: Mum, how about staying a few more days?
point: 挽留用 Why don't you…；Mum 是英式拼写

zh: 我能摸摸你的狗吗？
en: Is it OK if I pat your dog?
alt: Can I give your dog a pat?
point: “摸狗”说 pat，不说 touch

zh: 你能帮我喂几天猫吗？
en: Could you feed my cat for a few days?
alt: Would you mind feeding my cat for a few days?
point: “帮我喂”不用 help me feed，直接 Could you feed…

zh: 麻烦把狗拴上好吗？
en: Would you mind putting your dog on a lead?
alt: Could you put your dog on a leash?
point: “拴狗”说 put on a lead；Would you mind + -ing

zh: 我们能谈谈吗？
en: Can we have a chat?
alt: Could we talk for a minute?
point: “谈谈”说 have a chat，不是 talk talk

zh: 请别生我的气。
en: Please don't be upset with me.
alt: Please don't be cross with me.
point: “生我的气”是 be upset with me，不是 angry me

zh: 我想一个人待会儿。
en: I'd rather be on my own for a bit.
alt: I'd like some time to myself.
point: 委婉表达意愿用 I'd rather；“一个人待会儿”是 be on my own

zh: 今天下午你能帮我顶一下吗？我要去看医生。
en: Could you cover for me this afternoon? I've got a doctor's appointment.
alt: Would you mind covering for me this afternoon? I need to see the doctor.
point: “顶班、替我一下”说 cover for me，不是 replace me

zh: 我能借用一下你那台备用显示器吗？我的刚坏了。
en: Do you mind if I borrow your spare monitor? Mine's just died.
alt: Is it OK if I use your spare screen? Mine's just packed up.
point: 设备“坏了”口语说 died / packed up；Do you mind if I…

zh: 你做饭的时候能不能开一下抽油烟机？烟太大了。
en: Could you turn the extractor fan on when you cook? It gets really smoky.
alt: Can you put the rangehood on while you're cooking? It gets smoky.
point: “开”电器用 turn on；“抽油烟机”是 extractor fan / rangehood

zh: 这个能帮我留到明天吗？我明天来付钱。
en: Could you put this aside for me until tomorrow? I'll come back and pay.
alt: Would you be able to hold this for me till tomorrow? I'll pay then.
point: “帮我留着”说 put aside / hold，不是 keep for me tomorrow

zh: 剩下的能帮我们打包吗？我们想带回家。
en: Could we get the rest of this boxed up to take home?
alt: Would you mind boxing up the leftovers for us?
point: “打包”说 box up，不是 pack bag；get sth done 结构

zh: 你能先帮我垫一下吗？我晚点转给你。
en: Could you cover me for now? I'll transfer it to you later.
alt: Could you spot me for now? I'll pay you back later.
point: “帮我垫钱”说 cover me / spot me，不是 pad for me

zh: 你能陪我去一趟医院吗？我一个人去有点紧张。
en: Would you mind coming to the hospital with me? I'm a bit nervous about going alone.
alt: Could you come to the hospital with me? I don't really want to go on my own.
point: “陪我去”说 come with me；“有点怕”用 nervous about + -ing

zh: 能不能给我换个离厕所远一点的座位？
en: Is there any chance I could move to a seat away from the toilets?
alt: Would it be possible to swap to a seat further from the toilets?
point: Is there any chance I could… 很委婉；“离…远”说 away from

zh: 你要不要试试我的球拍？比你的轻多了。
en: Do you want to try my racquet? It's a lot lighter than yours.
alt: Want to have a go with my racquet? It's much lighter.
point: 让人试用说 Do you want to try / have a go with；racquet 是英式拼写

zh: 我能带个朋友一起来吗？他刚来新西兰。
en: Is it all right if I bring a friend along? He's new to New Zealand.
alt: Do you mind if I bring a mate? He's just arrived in New Zealand.
point: “带人一起来”说 bring sb along；“刚来”说 new to

zh: 您能再多介绍一下这个职位吗？
en: Could you tell me a bit more about the role?
alt: Would you mind telling me more about the position?
point: “职位”常说 role；Could you tell me a bit more about…

zh: 我下周二之前给您答复可以吗？
en: Would it be OK if I got back to you by next Tuesday?
alt: Could I let you know by next Tuesday?
point: “给您答复”说 get back to you；Would it be OK if I 后接过去式

zh: 面试完你最好发一封感谢邮件。
en: It might be a good idea to send a thank-you email after the interview.
alt: You could send a quick thank-you email after the interview.
point: It might be a good idea to… 是不强硬的建议，比 you must 自然

zh: 作业能晚交几天吗？我这周一直在生病。
en: Could I get an extension on my assignment? I've been sick all week.
alt: Is there any chance of an extension? I've been unwell this week.
point: “延期交作业”说 get an extension，不是 hand in late some days

zh: 老师，下课后能耽误您几分钟吗？我有个问题。
en: Could I grab you for a few minutes after class? I've got a quick question.
alt: Do you have a few minutes after class? I'd like to ask you something.
point: “耽误您几分钟”说 grab you for a few minutes，不是 delay you

zh: 那本书你可以去图书馆借，没必要买。
en: You could just borrow it from the library instead of buying it.
alt: Why not get it out of the library rather than buying it?
point: You could just… 是轻松的建议；“没必要买”用 instead of buying

zh: 我可以在墙上挂几幅画吗？需要钉几个钩子。
en: Would it be OK to hang a few pictures? I'd need to put some hooks in.
alt: Is it all right if I put up a few pictures? It'd mean a couple of hooks.
point: 向房东征求许可用 Would it be OK to…；“挂画”是 hang pictures

zh: 你搬走之前能把冰箱里你的东西清掉吗？
en: Could you clear your stuff out of the fridge before you move out?
alt: Can you empty your things from the fridge before you leave?
point: “清掉”说 clear out；“搬走”是 move out

zh: 房屋检查那天你能提前跟我说一声吗？
en: Could you give me a heads-up before the inspection?
alt: Would you mind letting me know before the inspection?
point: “提前说一声”说 give me a heads-up，很地道

zh: 周六晚上十一点以后能不能小声点？孩子们要睡觉。
en: Would you mind keeping the noise down after eleven on Saturday? The kids will be asleep.
alt: Could you keep it down after eleven on Saturday? My kids will be in bed.
point: “小声点”说 keep the noise down / keep it down

zh: 我们想修一下篱笆，费用一人一半行吗？
en: We're thinking of fixing the fence. Would you be happy to go halves?
alt: We'd like to fix the fence. How about we split the cost?
point: “一人一半”说 go halves；Would you be happy to… 很客气

zh: 我家猫丢了，你要是看到能告诉我一声吗？
en: Our cat's gone missing. Could you let me know if you see her?
alt: Our cat's disappeared. Would you give me a shout if you spot her?
point: “告诉我一声”说 let me know；“丢了”用 has gone missing

zh: 账单能不能改成发邮件，不要纸质的了？
en: Could you switch my bills to email instead of paper?
alt: Is it possible to get my bills by email rather than by post?
point: “改成”说 switch… to；“不要纸质的”用 instead of paper

zh: 您能帮我看看有没有更便宜的套餐可以换吗？
en: Could you check whether there's a cheaper plan I could switch to?
alt: Would you be able to see if there's a cheaper plan for me?
point: Could you check whether 后用陈述语序：there's…

zh: 厨房停电了，你能帮我看一下电闸吗？
en: Would you mind checking the fuse box? The power's gone off in the kitchen.
alt: Could you have a look at the switchboard? The kitchen's lost power.
point: “停电了”说 the power's gone off；“电闸”是 fuse box

zh: 你们周末能来修吗？我平时要上班。
en: Is there any way you could come at the weekend? I work during the week.
alt: Could you possibly come on a Saturday? I'm at work on weekdays.
point: Is there any way you could… 是委婉请求；英式说 at the weekend

zh: 修完以后能把这些垃圾一起带走吗？
en: Could you take the rubbish with you when you're done?
alt: Would you mind taking the waste away once you've finished?
point: “修完以后”说 when you're done；“带走”是 take with you

zh: 动水龙头之前，我建议你先把总阀关了。
en: I'd turn the water off at the mains before you touch that tap.
alt: I'd suggest switching the water off at the mains first.
point: I'd + 动词 就是“我建议”；“总阀”说 at the mains

zh: 您能帮我看看这张表填得对不对吗？
en: Could you check if I've filled this form in correctly?
alt: Would you mind checking I've filled this out right?
point: Could you check if + 陈述语序；“填表”是 fill in / fill out

zh: 我能约个时间当面咨询吗？电话里说不清楚。
en: Could I book a time to come in person? It's hard to explain over the phone.
alt: Would it be possible to come in and talk face to face? It's tricky to explain by phone.
point: “当面”说 in person；“电话里”是 over the phone

zh: 你最好把护照复印一份，以防万一。
en: You might want to make a copy of your passport, just in case.
alt: It's a good idea to keep a copy of your passport, just in case.
point: You might want to… 是委婉建议；“以防万一”说 just in case

zh: 你帮我按住伤口，我去拿急救包。
en: Could you keep pressure on the cut while I grab the first-aid kit?
alt: Can you press on the wound while I get the first-aid kit?
point: “按住伤口”说 keep pressure on the cut；“急救包”是 first-aid kit

zh: 先别往外跑，我们躲到桌子底下，等晃完再说。
en: Let's stay put and get under the table until the shaking stops.
alt: Don't run outside. Let's get under the table till it stops shaking.
point: “先别动”说 stay put；Let's 提议一起做

zh: 您能描述一下那个人长什么样吗？
en: Could you describe what the man looked like?
alt: Are you able to tell me what the man looked like?
point: describe 直接接宾语，不说 describe about；后用陈述语序

zh: 你在下个路口让我下车就行。
en: Could you just drop me off at the next corner?
alt: You can drop me at the next intersection, thanks.
point: “让我下车”说 drop me off，不是 let me get down

zh: 吃完午饭我来开吧，你都开了好几个小时了。
en: Shall I take over after lunch? You've been driving for hours.
alt: Do you want me to drive after lunch? You've been at the wheel for hours.
point: 主动接手说 Shall I take over；“开了好几个小时”用完成进行时

zh: 不好意思，能把包拿开吗？让别人坐一下。
en: Would you mind moving your bag so someone else can sit down?
alt: Excuse me, could you move your bag so someone can sit there?
point: Would you mind + -ing；目的用 so someone can…

zh: 快下雨了，我们找个地方躲一下吧。
en: It's about to rain. Shall we find somewhere to shelter?
alt: Looks like rain. Let's find somewhere to take cover.
point: “躲雨”说 shelter / take cover；“快要…了”是 be about to

zh: 带件外套吧，山顶上会很冷。
en: It's worth taking a jacket, because it gets cold up the top.
alt: You'll want a jacket, because it gets chilly at the summit.
point: It's worth + -ing 是实用建议；“山顶上”说 up the top

zh: 帐篷搭在这儿怎么样？离水近一点。
en: How about pitching the tent here, a bit closer to the water?
alt: Why don't we put the tent up here, nearer the water?
point: How about + -ing；“搭帐篷”是 pitch / put up a tent

zh: 演出的时候你能把手机调成静音吗？
en: Could you put your phone on silent during the show?
alt: Would you mind switching your phone to silent for the show?
point: “调成静音”说 put it on silent，不是 adjust to quiet

zh: 这本书你看完了能借我看看吗？
en: Could I borrow that book when you've finished with it?
alt: Can I have a read of that book once you're done?
point: “看完了”说 when you've finished with it，用现在完成时

zh: 我正在网上订票，要不要顺便帮你订一张？
en: Do you want me to grab you a ticket while I'm booking mine?
alt: I'm booking tickets now. Shall I get you one too?
point: “顺便帮你订”说 grab you one while I'm…

zh: 婚礼上我能坐你旁边吗？别的人我都不认识。
en: Mind if I sit with you at the wedding? I don't know anyone else.
alt: Can I sit next to you at the wedding? I don't really know anyone.
point: Mind if I… 是 Do you mind if I 的口语省略

zh: 大年三十来我家吃饭吧，我们包饺子。
en: Come round for dinner on New Year's Eve. We're making dumplings.
alt: Why don't you come over for dinner on New Year's Eve? We're doing dumplings.
point: 熟人邀请可直接用祈使句 Come round…；“包饺子”说 make dumplings

zh: 葬礼上能不能请你讲几句话？
en: Would you be willing to say a few words at the funeral?
alt: Would you feel up to saying a few words at the service?
point: “讲几句话”是 say a few words；Would you be willing to 很郑重

zh: 你能不能别在孩子面前说脏话？
en: Could you try not to swear in front of the kids?
alt: Would you mind not swearing around the kids?
point: 否定请求用 try not to / mind not -ing；“当面”是 in front of

zh: 周日我们带你爸妈去吃个早午餐吧，他们难得来一次。
en: Why don't we take your parents out for brunch on Sunday? They don't visit often.
alt: Let's take your mum and dad out for brunch on Sunday. They hardly ever visit.
point: Why don't we… 是提议；“带…去吃”说 take sb out for

zh: 你能帮我看一下宝宝吗？我出去十分钟就回来。
en: Could you mind the baby while I pop out for ten minutes?
alt: Can you watch the baby for ten minutes while I nip out?
point: “看孩子”说 mind / watch the baby；“出去一下”说 pop out

zh: 我能把狗带进来吗？它很乖的。
en: Is it OK to bring my dog inside? He's very well-behaved.
alt: Are dogs allowed in? Mine's really well-behaved.
point: 问规定用 Is it OK to…；“很乖”是 well-behaved，不是 obedient good

zh: 你出门的时候能顺便帮我遛一下狗吗？
en: Could you take my dog for a walk when you head out?
alt: Would you mind walking my dog while you're out?
point: “遛狗”说 take the dog for a walk / walk the dog

zh: 它这周几乎没吃东西，要不带它去看看兽医？
en: He's barely eaten all week. Maybe get him checked out by the vet?
alt: He's hardly eaten this week. Why not take him to the vet?
point: 省主语的 Maybe get… 是温和建议；“几乎没”是 barely

zh: 你能不能先听我说完再生气？
en: Could you hear me out before you get upset?
alt: Would you just let me finish before you get angry?
point: “听我说完”是 hear me out，不是 listen me finish

zh: 你要是想聊聊，随时给我打电话。
en: If you ever want to talk, just give me a call.
alt: Feel free to ring me any time you want to talk.
point: 安慰时用 If you ever want to…；“随时找我”说 just give me a call

zh: 对不起，我刚才说话太冲了，我们重新好好聊好吗？
en: Sorry I snapped at you. Can we start again?
alt: Sorry for snapping. Could we try that conversation again?
point: “说话太冲”说 snap at sb；Can we start again 用来和好

zh: 不知道你能不能帮我把这份合同打两份？打印机我弄不好。
en: I don't suppose you could print two copies of this contract? I can't get the printer to work.
alt: Could you possibly print two copies of this contract for me? I can't get the printer going.
point: I don't suppose you could… 是非常委婉的请求，带一点不好意思

zh: 这周的会议记录要不我来做吧？上周已经是你做的了。
en: Would it help if I took the minutes this week? You did them last week.
alt: Shall I take the minutes this week? You did them last time.
point: Would it help if I + 过去式，主动帮忙；“会议记录”是 take the minutes

zh: 我很想帮你，可是我手上的项目周五就要交，实在抽不出时间。
en: I'd love to help, but I've got a project due on Friday and I really can't spare the time.
alt: I'd really like to help, but I've got a Friday deadline and I'm flat out.
point: 婉拒先说 I'd love to, but…；“抽不出时间”说 can't spare the time

zh: 能帮我把账户解锁吗？我密码输错太多次了。
en: Would you be able to unlock my account? I've put the wrong password in too many times.
alt: Could you unlock my account for me? I've been locked out after too many wrong passwords.
point: Would you be able to 比 Can you 客气；输错密码 put the wrong one in

zh: 如果电脑一直这么慢，你试过清一下缓存吗？
en: If your laptop keeps running slowly, have you tried clearing the cache?
alt: If it's still slow, it might be worth clearing the cache.
point: Have you tried + -ing 其实是在给建议，不是真的问

zh: 装任何新软件之前，最好先跟IT部门打个招呼。
en: It'd be best to check with IT before you install any new software.
alt: Please run it past IT before installing any new software.
point: It'd be best to… 是客气的提醒；“打招呼”在这里是 check with

zh: 我想问一下，薪资方面还有没有商量的余地？
en: Would there be any room to move on the salary?
alt: Is there any flexibility on the salary?
Is the salary at all negotiable?
point: 谈薪资“商量余地”说 room to move / flexibility

zh: 如果您不介意，能告诉我这次为什么没被录用吗？
en: If you don't mind me asking, could you tell me why I wasn't successful this time?
alt: Would you mind giving me some feedback on why I didn't get the job?
point: 敏感问题先垫 If you don't mind me asking

zh: 我觉得你可以在求职信里多写写你在新西兰的工作经验。
en: You could probably say a bit more about your New Zealand experience in your cover letter.
alt: It might be worth adding more about your Kiwi work experience to your cover letter.
point: You could probably… 是委婉建议；“求职信”是 cover letter

zh: 如果你们小组还缺一个人，这次作业我能加入吗？
en: If your group's still a person short, could I join you for this assignment?
alt: If you're still short of a member, would you mind if I joined your group?
point: “还缺一个人”说 a person short / short of a member

zh: 你要是担心口语考试，可以多找个人一起练练。
en: If you're worried about the speaking test, it might help to practise with a partner.
alt: If the speaking exam's stressing you out, try practising with a partner.
point: it might help to… 是温和建议；动词 practise 英式拼写用 s

zh: 我挺想去学习小组的，可惜周四晚上我要上班。
en: I'd really like to come to the study group, but I work on Thursday nights.
alt: I'd love to join the study group, but I'm working Thursday nights.
point: 婉拒用 I'd really like to…, but…，后面给一个理由

zh: 你用完烤箱能不能顺手擦一下？里面都是油了。
en: Could you give the oven a wipe after you use it? It's getting pretty greasy.
alt: Would you mind wiping out the oven after you've used it? It's getting greasy.
point: “擦一下”说 give it a wipe，名词化更口语

zh: 要不我们把沙发挪到窗户边，这样客厅显得大一点？
en: What about moving the couch over by the window so the lounge feels bigger?
alt: How about putting the sofa by the window to make the lounge look bigger?
point: What about + -ing 提建议；新西兰客厅常叫 lounge

zh: 瓶子放进回收箱之前，最好先冲一下。
en: It's a good idea to rinse the bottles before you put them in the recycling bin.
alt: You'll want to give the bottles a rinse before they go in the recycling.
point: It's a good idea to… 是温和的提醒；“冲一下”是 rinse

zh: 请问能不能提前退租？我在别的城市找到了工作。
en: Would it be possible to end the lease early? I've got a job in another city.
alt: Is there any way I could break the lease early? I've been offered a job in another city.
point: “提前退租”说 end the lease early，不说 return the house early

zh: 房子有什么问题直接给我发短信就行，不用打电话。
en: Feel free to text me if anything comes up with the house. There's no need to call.
alt: Just flick me a text if there are any problems with the house. You don't need to ring.
point: Feel free to… 表示“随时可以”；“有什么问题”说 if anything comes up

zh: 去看房的时候，你最好问清楚房租包不包水费。
en: When you go to the viewing, you'd be wise to ask whether water's included in the rent.
alt: At the viewing, make sure you check if water's included in the rent.
point: you'd be wise to… 是委婉的劝告；“包不包”说 is included

zh: 你家的树枝伸到我们院子里了，你看能不能修剪一下？
en: Your tree's hanging over our fence a bit. Do you think you could trim it back?
alt: Your tree's growing over onto our side. Would you mind cutting it back a little?
point: Do you think you could… 比 Can you 更软；“修剪”是 trim back

zh: 这周六我们家来几个朋友，要是太吵了，直接来敲门就行。
en: We're having a few people over on Saturday, so just knock if we get too loud.
alt: We've got some friends coming over on Saturday. Let us know if it gets too noisy.
point: 提前打招呼：just knock if…；“来几个朋友”说 have people over

zh: 你们出去度假的话，我可以帮忙浇花，尽管开口。
en: If you're going away, I'm happy to water your plants. Just say the word.
alt: If you're away on holiday, I can water your garden. Just let me know.
point: 主动帮忙说 I'm happy to…；“尽管开口”是 just say the word

zh: 上个月电费比平时高很多，能帮我查一下是不是电表读错了？
en: My power bill was way higher than usual. Could you check if the meter was read correctly?
alt: Last month's power bill was much higher than normal. Could you check the meter reading?
point: Could you check if 后用陈述语序；“读表”是 read the meter

zh: 我下个月搬家，宽带能不能转到新地址？
en: I'm moving next month. Is it possible to transfer my broadband to the new address?
alt: I'm moving house next month. Could I move my internet connection to the new place?
point: Is it possible to… 适合问服务商；“转到”用 transfer… to

zh: 套餐我就先不升级了，谢谢，现在这个挺好的。
en: I'll pass on the upgrade for now, thanks. I'm happy with what I've got.
alt: I think I'll stick with my current plan, thanks. It's working fine.
point: 拒绝推销说 I'll pass on…, thanks，不说 I don't need

zh: 我家洗衣机漏水了，你们这周能派人过来看看吗？
en: My washing machine's leaking. Would you be able to send someone round this week?
alt: My washing machine has sprung a leak. Could someone come and look at it this week?
point: “漏水”用进行时 is leaking；“派人过来”说 send someone round

zh: 这个报价比我想的高一点，有没有便宜一点的修法？
en: The quote's a bit more than I was expecting. Is there a cheaper way to do it?
alt: That's a bit over my budget. Is there a more affordable option?
point: 压价先说 more than I was expecting，再问更便宜的做法

zh: 你要是不确定问题出在哪，还是请个正规电工来看比较好。
en: If you're not sure what's wrong, you'd be better off getting a proper electrician in.
alt: If you can't tell what the problem is, it's safer to call in a qualified electrician.
point: you'd be better off + -ing 表示“还是…更好”；“请人来”说 get someone in

zh: 我网上下的单还没到，能帮我查一下到哪儿了吗？
en: My online order still hasn't turned up. Could you find out where it's got to?
alt: My order hasn't arrived yet. Could you track down where it is?
point: “到哪儿了”说 where it's got to；“没到”说 hasn't turned up

zh: 这双鞋能换个颜色吗？我还没穿过。
en: Would I be able to swap these shoes for a different colour? I haven't worn them.
alt: Could I exchange these for another colour? They haven't been worn.
point: “换一个”说 swap… for；colour 用英式拼写

zh: 你要是不急，不如等到黑色星期五打折再买。
en: If you're not in a hurry, you might as well wait for the Black Friday sales.
alt: If there's no rush, I'd hold off until the Black Friday sales.
point: you might as well… 表示“不如…”，比 you should 轻松

zh: 我们能换到外面坐吗？里面有点吵。
en: Any chance we could sit outside instead? It's a bit loud in here.
alt: Would it be OK if we moved to a table outside? It's quite noisy in here.
point: Any chance we could… 很口语；用 instead 表示换位置

zh: 你要是吃不了辣，我推荐黄油鸡，那个一点都不辣。
en: If you can't handle spicy food, I'd go for the butter chicken. It's pretty mild.
alt: If you're not into spicy food, try the butter chicken. It's quite mild.
point: 推荐菜用 I'd go for…；“不辣”说 mild，不是 not hot

zh: 今天这顿我来，下次你请。
en: Let me get this one, and you can shout next time.
alt: This one's on me. You can get the next one.
point: “我请”说 Let me get this；Kiwi 用 shout 表示请客

zh: 上周电费是你付的，我把我那份转给你吧？
en: You paid the power bill last week, so shall I transfer you my share?
alt: Since you covered the power bill last week, do you want me to send you my half?
point: Shall I… 主动提出；“我那份”说 my share

zh: 你要是打算买房，最好先找个贷款顾问聊聊。
en: If you're thinking of buying a house, it'd be worth talking to a mortgage adviser first.
alt: If you're looking at buying, you might want to see a mortgage broker first.
point: it'd be worth + -ing；“房贷顾问”是 mortgage adviser

zh: 如果有人打电话说是银行的，最稳妥的是挂掉，自己再打给银行。
en: If someone calls saying they're from the bank, the safest thing is to hang up and ring the bank yourself.
alt: If a caller says they're from your bank, it's safest to hang up and call the bank back directly.
point: “最稳妥的做法”说 the safest thing is to…；“挂掉”是 hang up

zh: 请问我的签证申请有没有办法加急？我母亲病了。
en: Is there any way my visa application could be fast-tracked? My mother's unwell.
alt: Would it be possible to speed up my visa application? My mum's not well.
point: 委婉请求：Is there any way… could be + 过去分词；“加急”说 fast-track

zh: 你要是不知道税表怎么填，干嘛不给IRD打个电话问问？
en: If you're not sure how to fill in the tax form, why not give IRD a ring?
alt: If the tax form's confusing you, you could always call IRD.
point: Why not + 动词原形 是建议；“打个电话”说 give sb a ring

zh: 这封信能寄可追踪的吗？我想确保它能寄到。
en: Could I send this by tracked post? I want to make sure it gets there.
alt: Can I send this with tracking? I need to be sure it arrives.
point: “可追踪邮寄”说 tracked post；“寄到”口语说 gets there

zh: 医生，我不想马上吃药，能不能先试试别的办法？
en: I'd rather not go on medication straight away. Could we try something else first?
alt: I'm not keen on starting medication just yet. Are there other options we could try first?
point: 婉拒说 I'd rather not…；“开始吃药”说 go on medication

zh: 您能告诉我这个感冒药开车前能不能吃吗？
en: Could you tell me if this cold medicine is OK to take before driving?
alt: Is it safe to drive after taking this cold medicine, do you know?
point: Could you tell me if… 陈述语序；“能不能吃”说 is OK to take

zh: 你牙疼了这么久，真的应该去看看牙医了。
en: Your tooth's been hurting for ages, so you really ought to see a dentist.
alt: You've had that toothache for ages. You really should get it looked at.
point: ought to 比 must 柔和；“疼了很久”用 has been hurting for ages

zh: 刚才的事故您都看到了，能不能留个电话，万一保险公司需要证人？
en: Would you mind leaving your number in case the insurance company needs a witness?
alt: Could I get your number in case the insurer needs a witness statement?
point: Would you mind + -ing；“万一”说 in case + 一般现在时

zh: 我好像把钱包落在你们店里了，能帮我看看有没有人交上来吗？
en: I think I left my wallet here. Could you check if anyone's handed it in?
alt: I might have dropped my wallet in here. Has anyone handed one in, by any chance?
point: “捡到交上来”说 hand in；“落下”用 left

zh: 听说今晚暴风雨很厉害，要不要来我们家住一晚？
en: Do you want to come and stay at ours tonight? The storm's meant to be really bad.
alt: Why don't you stay over at our place tonight? They're saying the storm will be nasty.
point: “我们家”口语说 ours；“听说”可用 be meant to be

zh: 你能在超市门口等我五分钟吗？我很快就出来。
en: Could you wait outside the supermarket for five minutes? I'll be quick.
alt: Would you mind waiting out the front of the supermarket? I won't be long.
point: 请人等说 Could you wait…；“很快出来”说 I'll be quick

zh: 你的WOF快过期了，最好这周就预约去检。
en: Your WOF's about to run out, so it'd be a good idea to book it in this week.
alt: Your WOF's nearly due, so you might want to get it booked in this week.
point: “快过期”说 run out；“预约”车检说 book it in

zh: 我开车送你去机场吧，反正我顺路。
en: Let me drop you at the airport. It's on my way anyway.
alt: I'll take you to the airport. It's no trouble, it's on my way.
point: 主动帮忙用 Let me…；“顺路”说 on my way

zh: 我们能不能晚点退房？航班是晚上的。
en: Would it be possible to have a late checkout? Our flight isn't until the evening.
alt: Could we check out a bit later? Our flight's not till the evening.
point: “晚退房”说 late checkout；“晚上才飞”用 not until

zh: 买个旅游保险不是更保险吗？万一航班取消呢。
en: Wouldn't it be safer to get travel insurance, in case the flight gets cancelled?
alt: Don't you think it'd be wise to get travel insurance in case the flight's cancelled?
point: 否定疑问 Wouldn't it be… 是委婉建议，不是质问

zh: 昨晚太吵了没睡着，能给我们换一间不朝马路的房间吗？
en: Could we possibly move to a room that doesn't face the road? We couldn't sleep last night.
alt: Is there any chance of a quieter room away from the road? We barely slept last night.
point: Could we possibly… 更客气；“朝马路”说 face the road

zh: 今天紫外线很强，要不要借你一顶帽子？
en: The UV's really strong today. Do you want to borrow a hat?
alt: The sun's fierce today. Want to borrow one of my hats?
point: 提出借东西给对方：Do you want to borrow…

zh: 如果天气变了，汤加里罗徒步我们就改天再去吧。
en: If the weather turns, let's save the Tongariro Crossing for another day.
alt: If the weather packs in, we could do the Tongariro Crossing another time.
point: “天气变坏”说 the weather turns；“改天”说 save it for another day

zh: 你要下水的话最好在两面旗子中间游，今天浪很大。
en: Best to stay between the flags if you're swimming. The waves are huge today.
alt: If you're going in, I'd swim between the flags. The surf's really big today.
point: Best to… 是 It's best to 的口语省略；“旗子中间”是 between the flags

zh: 你能帮我看看我深蹲的姿势吗？我不确定背是不是直的。
en: Would you mind watching my squat? I'm not sure if my back's straight.
alt: Could you check my squat form? I'm not sure my back's staying straight.
point: Would you mind + -ing；健身动作“姿势”说 form

zh: 我们一起报名半程马拉松吧，有个伴更容易坚持。
en: Why don't we sign up for the half marathon together? It'd keep us both motivated.
alt: How about we both enter the half marathon? It'd help us stay motivated.
point: Why don't we… 提议；“报名”说 sign up for

zh: 你要是想看橄榄球赛，欢迎来我家看，我们有天空台。
en: If you want to watch the rugby, you're welcome to come round to ours. We've got Sky.
alt: Feel free to come over and watch the rugby at ours. We've got Sky.
point: you're welcome to… 是热情邀请；“来我家”说 come round to ours

zh: 不好意思，明天的理发我得取消了，能改到下周吗？
en: I'm afraid I'll have to cancel my haircut tomorrow. Could I rebook for next week?
alt: Sorry, I can't make my haircut tomorrow. Could I move it to next week?
point: I'm afraid 用来软化坏消息；“改约”说 rebook

zh: 读书会下个月看什么书，要不你来选？
en: How would you feel about picking the book for next month's book club?
alt: Do you want to choose next month's book for book club?
point: How would you feel about + -ing 是很软的提议

zh: 你们玩吧，我在旁边看就好，我玩得太烂了。
en: You go ahead and play. I'm happy just watching, since I'm hopeless at it.
alt: You guys play. I'll just watch, because I'm terrible at it.
point: 推辞说 You go ahead；“看就好”说 I'm happy just watching

zh: 下次我们聚的时候你也一起来吧，大家都想认识你。
en: You should come along next time we catch up. Everyone would love to meet you.
alt: Come along next time we get together. Everyone's keen to meet you.
point: You should… 也可以是热情邀请，不一定是劝告

zh: 今晚我就不喝酒了，谢谢，我还要开车回家。
en: I'll stick to water tonight, thanks. I'm driving home.
alt: I'm on the soft drinks tonight, thanks. I've got to drive home.
point: 婉拒喝酒说 I'll stick to…，不说 I don't drink today

zh: 这里太吵了，我们找个安静点的地方聊吧？
en: Shall we go somewhere a bit quieter? I can hardly hear you.
alt: Do you want to head somewhere quieter? I can barely hear you.
point: Shall we go somewhere…；“听不清”说 can hardly hear

zh: 圣诞节你要是没地方去，就来我们家一起过吧。
en: If you haven't got plans for Christmas, you're more than welcome to join us.
alt: If you're on your own at Christmas, come and spend it with us.
point: you're more than welcome to… 表示“非常欢迎”

zh: 她过生日我们要不要给她办个惊喜派对？
en: How about we throw her a surprise party for her birthday?
alt: What if we threw her a surprise birthday party?
point: “办派对”说 throw a party；How about we + 动词原形

zh: 红包里别放太多钱，意思一下就行了。
en: I wouldn't put too much in the red envelope. It's the thought that counts.
alt: You don't need to put much in the red envelope. It's the gesture that matters.
point: I wouldn't… 是委婉劝阻；“意思一下”说 it's the thought that counts

zh: 这周的家长会你能替我去吗？我要出差。
en: Could you go to the parent-teacher interview for me this week? I'll be away for work.
alt: Would you be able to do the parent-teacher meeting this week? I'm away on a work trip.
point: “家长会”说 parent-teacher interview；“出差”说 away for work

zh: 你要是累了，今晚孩子我来哄睡吧。
en: If you're tired, let me put the kids to bed tonight.
alt: If you're worn out, I'll do bedtime with the kids tonight.
point: “哄孩子睡觉”说 put the kids to bed；主动分担用 let me

zh: 宝贝，你能不能用自己的话跟妹妹道个歉？
en: Do you think you could say sorry to your sister in your own words?
alt: Can you tell your sister you're sorry, in your own words?
point: 对孩子也可用 Do you think you could…；“道歉”口语说 say sorry

zh: 我们去度假的时候，狗能不能寄养在你家？
en: Would you be able to have our dog while we're on holiday?
alt: Could our dog stay with you while we're away on holiday?
point: “寄养在你家”简单说 have our dog；“度假”是 on holiday

zh: 请问我能不能养一只猫？我保证不会弄坏东西。
en: Would you consider letting me have a cat? I'll make sure it doesn't damage anything.
alt: Would you be open to me getting a cat? I'll make sure nothing gets damaged.
point: Would you consider + -ing 是小心翼翼的请求

zh: 你家狗老跑进我们院子，能不能记得把门关好？
en: Your dog keeps getting into our yard. Could you make sure the gate's shut?
alt: Your dog keeps wandering into our garden. Would you mind keeping the gate closed?
point: 请人注意用 Could you make sure…；“老是”用 keeps -ing

zh: 你要是心情不好，我们出去转转吧，别一个人闷在家里。
en: If you're feeling down, let's get out of the house for a bit. Don't sit at home on your own.
alt: If you're feeling low, how about we head out for a while instead of moping at home?
point: 安慰加提议用 let's…；“心情不好”说 feeling down

zh: 我知道你是好意，但这件事我想自己处理。
en: I know you mean well, but I'd rather deal with this myself.
alt: I appreciate it, but I'd prefer to sort this out on my own.
point: 婉拒帮助：I know you mean well, but I'd rather…

zh: 如果我刚才的话让你不舒服了，我向你道歉。
en: I'm sorry if what I said came across the wrong way.
alt: Sorry if that came out wrong. I didn't mean to upset you.
point: “让你不舒服”可说 came across the wrong way

zh: 我知道你最近忙得不可开交，不过能不能抽半个小时，带新同事熟悉一下系统？
en: I know you're pretty snowed under at the moment, but could you spare half an hour to show the new starter around the system?
alt: I know you're flat out right now, but would you be able to take half an hour to walk the new person through the system?
point: “忙得不可开交”说 snowed under；“新同事”是 new starter

zh: 我们是不是可以考虑开启双重验证？最近钓鱼邮件越来越多，我觉得值得做。
en: Could we look at turning on two-factor authentication? We've been getting a lot more phishing emails lately, and I think it'd be worth it.
alt: Should we think about switching on two-factor authentication? Phishing emails have really picked up lately.
point: 会议上提建议用 Could we look at + -ing

zh: 你好，我想订周六晚上四个人的位子，有一位坐轮椅，能不能安排一个方便进出的桌子？
en: Hi, I'd like a table for four on Saturday night. One of us uses a wheelchair, so could we have an accessible table?
alt: Hi, could I book a table for four this Saturday evening? One of our group is in a wheelchair, so somewhere easy to get to would be great.
point: 订位说 I'd like a table for…；“方便进出”说 accessible

zh: 教练，不好意思，下周的训练我得请假，我知道决赛快到了，但家里有件事实在推不掉。
en: Sorry, coach, I'm going to have to miss training next week. I know the final's close, but there's a family thing I can't get out of.
alt: Sorry, coach, I won't be able to make training next week. I know it's close to the final, but I've got a family commitment I can't move.
point: “推不掉”说 can't get out of；I'm going to have to… 软化坏消息

zh: 我上周买的吸尘器才用了两次就坏了，我不要退款，能不能直接给我换一台新的？
en: The vacuum cleaner I bought last week stopped working after two uses. Rather than a refund, would it be possible to swap it for a new one?
alt: The vacuum I bought here last week died after only two uses. Instead of a refund, could I just get a replacement?
point: Rather than a refund 先说偏好；“换新的”说 swap it for a new one

zh: 如果你们需要的话，我可以把靠窗的座位换给你们，这样你们一家人能坐在一起。
en: If it helps, I'm happy to swap my window seat with you so your family can all sit together.
alt: If you like, I can switch seats with you so your whole family can sit together.
point: 主动让座说 If it helps, I'm happy to…，不说 If you need

zh: 请问能不能改成下午的预约？我早上要送孩子上学，实在走不开。
en: Is there any chance I could have an afternoon appointment instead? I do the school run in the mornings, so it's really hard to get away.
alt: Would it be possible to switch to an afternoon slot? I've got the school drop-off in the mornings and can't really get away.
point: “送孩子上学”说 the school run；“走不开”说 get away

zh: 要不这个周末我们一起把车库收拾一下？东西堆得太多了，我连车都停不进去。
en: How about we tackle the garage together this weekend? There's so much junk in there I can't even get the car in.
alt: Why don't we sort out the garage this weekend? It's so full of stuff I can't fit the car in.
point: 收拾“难搞的活”说 tackle；How about we + 动词原形

zh: 不好意思这么晚才回你，周五的晚饭我很想去，不过可能要晚点到，八点左右，可以吗？
en: Sorry for the slow reply. I'd love to come to dinner on Friday, but I might be a bit late, around eight. Is that OK?
alt: Sorry it took me a while to get back to you. I'd love to come on Friday, but I probably won't get there until about eight. Hope that's all right.
point: 回复邀请先说 Sorry for the slow reply；接受加条件 but I might…

zh: 你要是不确定这笔贷款怎么还，我建议你先找银行谈谈，看能不能把还款期拉长一点。
en: If you're not sure how you'll manage the repayments, I'd suggest talking to the bank about stretching out the loan term.
alt: If the repayments are going to be tight, it might be worth asking the bank about extending the loan.
point: I'd suggest + -ing；“延长还款期”说 stretch out the loan term

zh: 非常感谢您给我这个机会，不过考虑之后，我决定接受另一份工作，希望以后还有机会合作。
en: Thank you so much for the offer, but after a lot of thought I've decided to accept another role. I hope our paths cross again.
alt: Thanks very much for the offer. After careful thought, I've decided to go with another position, but I hope we get to work together in future.
point: 婉拒 offer 先感谢；“以后再合作”可说 our paths cross again

zh: 请问入职时间能不能往后推两周？我需要在现在的公司做完通知期。
en: Would it be possible to push the start date back by a couple of weeks? I need to work out my notice.
alt: Is there any flexibility on the start date? I've got two more weeks of notice to work at my current job.
point: “往后推”说 push back；“做完通知期”说 work out my notice

zh: 你下周要是有空，能不能一起喝杯咖啡？我挺想了解一下在你们公司工作是什么感觉。
en: If you've got time next week, would you be up for a quick coffee? I'd love to hear what it's like working at your company.
alt: Would you be keen to grab a coffee next week? I'm really interested in what it's like to work there.
point: would you be up for… 是轻松邀请；“了解情况”说 hear what it's like

zh: 我知道截止日期已经过了，可我上周家里出了急事，请问还有没有办法交论文？
en: I realise the deadline's passed, but I had a family emergency last week. Is there any way I could still submit my essay?
alt: I know I've missed the deadline, but there was a family emergency last week. Would I still be able to hand in my essay?
point: 先用 I realise… 承认问题，再提请求；“交论文”正式说 submit

zh: 你要是觉得自学太难，不妨报个晚上的英语课，既能练口语，又能认识新朋友。
en: If you're finding it hard to study on your own, you could always try an evening English class. You'd get speaking practice and meet new people too.
alt: If studying alone isn't working, why not sign up for a night class in English? You'd practise speaking and make some friends.
point: you could always… 表示“不妨试试”，语气轻松

zh: 明天小组开会之前，你能不能先把你那部分发到群里，大家好提前看一下？
en: Could you post your section in the group chat before tomorrow's meeting? That way everyone can have a look beforehand.
alt: Would you mind sharing your part in the group chat before tomorrow's meeting, so we can all read it first?
point: 用 That way… 说明好处；“提前”说 beforehand

zh: 你好，我是12号的租客，浴室排风扇坏了快两个星期了，能不能尽快安排人来修？
en: Hi, it's the tenant at number 12. The bathroom fan's been broken for nearly two weeks. Could you get someone out to fix it soon?
alt: Hi, this is the tenant from number 12. Our bathroom extractor fan has been broken for almost two weeks. Would you be able to send someone soon?
point: 电话开头说 it's the tenant at…；“安排人来修”说 get someone out

zh: 我们下个月底搬走，请问能不能早点做最终检查，好让我们早点拿回押金？
en: We're moving out at the end of next month. Would you be able to do the final inspection early so we can get our bond back sooner?
alt: We're leaving at the end of next month. Is there any chance of an early final inspection, so our bond can be released sooner?
point: “拿回押金”说 get our bond back；目的用 so we can…

zh: 我们几个室友商量了一下，想以后网费和电费都平摊，从一个共同账户里付。
en: We've had a chat as flatmates, and we were thinking we could split the internet and power evenly and pay them from a joint account.
alt: We flatmates were talking, and we wondered if we could share the internet and power equally out of a joint account.
point: we were thinking we could… 用过去进行时，提议更软

zh: 我们下个月要翻新厨房，可能会有点吵，要是给你们添了麻烦，随时告诉我们。
en: We're having the kitchen redone next month, so there might be a bit of noise. If it's ever a problem, please don't hesitate to let us know.
alt: We're getting the kitchen renovated next month, so it could get noisy. Just tell us if it's bothering you.
point: please don't hesitate to… 是客气的“随时告诉我们”

zh: 街坊们周日上午搞清洁活动，你要是有空欢迎来帮忙，结束后还有烤香肠。
en: Some of us on the street are doing a clean-up on Sunday morning. You'd be very welcome to join in, and there's a sausage sizzle afterwards.
alt: A few neighbours are tidying up the street on Sunday morning. Feel free to come and help, and there's a sausage sizzle after.
point: You'd be very welcome to… 是热情邀请；“之后”说 afterwards

zh: 不好意思提这个，你的车今天早上挡住了我家车道一部分，下次能不能稍微往前停一点？
en: I hate to bring this up, but your car was partly blocking our driveway this morning. Would you mind parking a bit further up next time?
alt: Sorry to mention it, but your car was blocking part of our driveway this morning. Could you park a little further along next time?
point: 提意见先垫一句 I hate to bring this up；“挡住车道”是 block the driveway

zh: 我们这条街从昨晚开始就停电了，请问你们知道大概什么时候能恢复吗？
en: Our street's been without power since last night. Would you have any idea when it might be back on?
alt: The power's been out on our street since last night. Do you know roughly when it'll be restored?
point: Would you have any idea when… 比 When 更委婉；“恢复供电”说 be back on

zh: 我要搬去国外了，得提前取消合约，请问违约金能不能免掉？
en: I need to cancel my contract because I'm moving overseas. Is there any chance you could waive the early termination fee?
alt: I'm moving overseas, so I'll have to end my contract early. Would you consider waiving the cancellation fee?
point: “免掉费用”说 waive the fee；“违约金”是 early termination fee

zh: 你们的技术员说好今天上午来装光纤，可到现在还没人来，能帮我问一下怎么回事吗？
en: Your technician was meant to come this morning to install the fibre, but no one's turned up yet. Could you find out what's happened?
alt: The technician was supposed to install our fibre this morning, but nobody's arrived. Would you mind checking what's going on?
point: “说好要来”说 was meant to；Could you find out… 请对方查

zh: 这个价格我能接受，不过能不能先付一半，修好了再付剩下的？
en: I'm happy with the price, but would you be OK with half up front and the rest when the job's done?
alt: The price is fine, but could I pay half now and the other half once it's finished?
point: would you be OK with… 商量付款方式；“预付”说 up front

zh: 你们干完活能不能顺便把地上的灰扫一下？我下午有客人要来。
en: When you're finished, would you mind giving the floor a quick sweep? I've got people coming over this afternoon.
alt: Once you're done, could you sweep up the dust? I've got guests coming this afternoon.
point: “扫一下”说 give the floor a sweep；“有客人来”说 people coming over

zh: 你们这周要是排不开，能不能给我推荐一个靠谱的水管工？漏水一天比一天严重。
en: If you're fully booked this week, could you recommend another plumber you'd trust? The leak's getting worse by the day.
alt: If you can't fit me in this week, would you know a reliable plumber who could? The leak's getting worse every day.
point: “排不开”说 fully booked；“靠谱的”说 one you'd trust

zh: 我昨天交了驾照申请，好像传错了照片，您能帮我改一下吗？还是得重新申请？
en: I submitted my licence application yesterday, but I think I uploaded the wrong photo. Could you update it for me, or would I need to reapply?
alt: I applied for my licence yesterday and I think I attached the wrong photo. Is it possible to change it, or do I have to start again?
point: 名词 licence 英式拼写；给对方两个选项用 or would I need to…

zh: 你好，我想下周约个时间去市议会，咨询一下建房许可的事，有空位吗？
en: Hi, I'd like to book a time to talk to someone about a building consent next week. Do you have anything available?
alt: Hi, I was hoping to make an appointment next week to discuss a building consent. Is there anything free?
point: “建房许可”是 building consent；问空档说 Do you have anything available

zh: 请问这些文件的原件能还给我吗？我下周去大使馆还要用。
en: Would it be possible to have the originals back? I need them for an embassy appointment next week.
alt: Could I get the original documents back? I'll need them at the embassy next week.
point: “原件”是 the originals；Would it be possible to have… back

zh: 你好，我想报告一起车祸，没人受伤，但有辆车挡在路中间，能派人来处理一下吗？
en: Hi, I'd like to report a crash. Nobody's hurt, but one of the cars is blocking the road. Could you send someone out?
alt: Hi, I'm calling to report an accident. No one's injured, but a car's stuck in the middle of the road. Can someone come out?
point: 报案开头说 I'd like to report…；车祸口语说 crash

zh: 我家附近一块空地上冒出好多烟，我不确定严不严重，但能不能派人来看看？
en: There's a lot of smoke coming from a section near my place. I'm not sure if it's serious, but could someone come and check it out?
alt: There's heavy smoke coming off an empty section near my house. It might be nothing, but could someone take a look?
point: 不确定时先说 I'm not sure if it's serious, but…；空地叫 section

zh: 我在超市停车场捡到一个钱包，可以交给你们吗？还是得送去警察局？
en: I found a wallet in the supermarket car park. Would it be OK to hand it in here, or should I take it to the police?
alt: I picked up a wallet in the car park. Can I leave it with you, or is it better to take it to the police station?
point: “交给”说 hand it in；Would it be OK to…, or should I…?

zh: 你好，我的车刹车最近有点响，这周能帮我检查一下吗？顺便把WOF也做了。
en: Hi, my brakes have been squealing a bit lately. Could you have a look at them this week and do the WOF while it's in?
alt: Hi, my brakes are making a squeaking noise. Would you be able to check them this week and do the WOF at the same time?
point: “顺便”说 while it's in；“刹车响”说 squealing

zh: 高速堵死了，要不我们先在附近吃点东西，等高峰过了再走？
en: The motorway's chocka. Why don't we grab a bite nearby and head off once the rush hour's over?
alt: The motorway's jammed. How about we get something to eat nearby and leave after rush hour?
point: Kiwi 说堵车 chocka；Why don't we… 提议

zh: 不好意思，我车停得太近了，你稍等一下，我把车挪开你就能出来了。
en: Sorry, I've parked a bit close. If you give me a sec, I'll move my car so you can get out.
alt: Sorry, I'm parked too close. Hang on a moment and I'll shift my car so you can get out.
point: 请人稍等说 If you give me a sec；目的用 so you can…

zh: 我们下午要走一条四小时的步道，你要是体力跟得上，干脆跟我们一起去吧？
en: We're doing a four-hour walk this afternoon. If you're feeling up to it, why not tag along?
alt: We're heading out on a four-hour walk this afternoon. Come with us if you're up for it.
point: “体力跟得上”说 feeling up to it；“跟着一起”说 tag along

zh: 我觉得我们最好天黑前下山，要不就在这儿吃午饭，然后往回走？
en: I reckon we should aim to be off the hill before dark. How about we have lunch here and then head back?
alt: We should probably get down before it gets dark. Why don't we eat lunch here and then turn back?
point: Kiwi 常说 I reckon…；“下山”说 be off the hill

zh: 你家柠檬树今年结了好多，要是吃不完，能不能分我几个？
en: Your lemon tree's loaded this year. If you've got more than you can use, could I grab a few?
alt: Your lemon tree's covered in fruit. If you can't use them all, would you mind if I took a few?
point: “吃不完”说 more than you can use；“果子满树”说 loaded

zh: 我们乐队下周五在酒吧演出，你有空就来捧个场吧，我把你加到嘉宾名单上。
en: My band's playing at the pub next Friday. Come along and support us if you're free, and I'll put you on the guest list.
alt: We're playing a gig at the pub next Friday. Come and support us if you can, and I'll get you on the guest list.
point: “捧场”说 come and support us；“加名单”说 put you on the guest list

zh: 不好意思，您能把帽子摘一下吗？我在后面看不到屏幕。
en: Sorry, would you mind taking your hat off? I can't really see the screen from back here.
alt: Excuse me, could you take your hat off? I can't see the screen from behind you.
point: Would you mind taking your hat off；“在后面”说 from back here

zh: 我知道你很喜欢那个乐队，但演唱会票太贵了，我这次就不去了，你们玩得开心。
en: I know you're really into them, but the tickets are a bit steep for me, so I'll give this one a miss. Have a great time!
alt: I know you love that band, but the tickets are too pricey for me this time, so I'll sit this one out. Enjoy!
point: “太贵”说 a bit steep；“这次不去”说 give this one a miss

zh: 下周是Tom的欢送会，我们打算一起给他买份礼物，你要是想参与，转二十块给我就行。
en: We're getting Tom a farewell present next week. If you'd like to be part of it, just send me twenty bucks.
alt: We're putting together a leaving gift for Tom next week. If you want in, just transfer me twenty dollars.
point: If you'd like to… 给对方选择，不显得强迫

zh: 谢谢你们邀请我参加婚礼，我真的很想去，可惜那周我在国外，实在赶不回来。
en: Thank you so much for the wedding invitation. I'd have loved to come, but I'm overseas that week and can't get back in time.
alt: Thanks so much for inviting me to the wedding. I'd really love to be there, but I'll be overseas that week and won't make it back.
point: I'd have loved to… 是遗憾的婉拒；“赶不回来”说 can't get back in time

zh: 奶奶的八十大寿是去餐厅还是在家办？我倾向于在家，感觉更温馨，你们觉得呢？
en: Should we do Nana's eightieth at a restaurant or at home? I'd lean towards home, as it feels more personal. What do you all think?
alt: Shall we have Nana's eightieth at a restaurant or at home? I'd prefer home because it's cosier. What does everyone reckon?
point: 表达倾向说 I'd lean towards…；“八十大寿”说 eightieth

zh: 老师您好，Lily的奶奶最近去世了，她情绪不太好，如果她在学校有什么异常，能告诉我一声吗？
en: Lily's grandmother passed away recently and she's been quite upset. If you notice anything unusual at school, could you let me know?
alt: Lily lost her grandmother recently and she's been struggling. Would you mind letting me know if anything seems off at school?
point: “去世”委婉说 passed away；If you notice…, could you let me know

zh: 要不这个周末孩子们去你家玩，下周末来我家，轮着来，大家都能喘口气？
en: What if the kids played at yours this weekend and ours the next? That way we'd both get a bit of a breather.
alt: How about the kids go to yours this weekend and mine next weekend, so we both get a break?
point: What if + 过去式 提议；“喘口气”说 a breather

zh: 爸，您别老帮我们带孩子了，您也该好好歇歇，我们可以请个保姆。
en: Dad, you don't have to look after the kids all the time. You deserve a rest, and we could always get a babysitter.
alt: Dad, you don't need to mind the kids so often. You should have a rest, and we can always hire a babysitter.
point: you don't have to… 是体贴地劝人别做，不是命令

zh: 你好，想问一下这个周末还能接狗寄宿吗？我们周五送过来，周日晚上接走。
en: Hi, I was wondering if you've got any space for a dog this weekend? We'd drop him off Friday and pick him up Sunday night.
alt: Hi, do you have room for one more dog this weekend? We'd bring him in on Friday and collect him on Sunday evening.
point: I was wondering if… 问有没有位置；“送来/接走”说 drop off / pick up

zh: 兽医说要做手术，费用有点高，我能不能先考虑一两天，跟家里人商量一下？
en: Would it be all right if I took a day or two to think about the surgery? I'd like to talk it over with my family.
alt: Could I have a couple of days to think about the operation? I want to discuss it with my family first.
point: 争取时间说 take a day or two to think；“商量”是 talk it over

zh: 你家狗很可爱，但我孩子有点怕狗，你遛狗经过的时候能不能把绳子收短一点？
en: Your dog's lovely, but my kids are a bit scared of dogs. Would you mind keeping him on a short lead when you walk past?
alt: He's a lovely dog, but my children get nervous around dogs. Could you keep him close when you go past?
point: 先夸再提请求；“绳子收短”说 keep him on a short lead

zh: 我知道你最近事情特别多，如果有什么我能帮上忙的，别客气，尽管说。
en: I know you've had a lot on your plate lately. If there's anything I can do to help, just let me know.
alt: I know things have been really full-on for you lately. If I can help in any way, just say.
point: “事情多压力大”说 a lot on your plate；If there's anything I can do…

zh: 我们先冷静一下，明天再谈好吗？现在继续说下去只会越吵越凶。
en: Can we take a break and talk about this tomorrow? If we keep going now, we'll just end up arguing more.
alt: Shall we leave it for tonight and pick it up tomorrow? We'll only end up fighting if we carry on now.
point: “先冷静一下”说 take a break；“最后只会”是 end up -ing

zh: 我明白你的想法，但我还是觉得这事得先问问爸妈的意见。
en: I see where you're coming from, but I still think we should run it by Mum and Dad first.
alt: I understand your point, but I still reckon we should check with Mum and Dad first.
point: 委婉反对说 I see where you're coming from, but…；“征求意见”是 run it by

zh: 我想正式申请每周在家办公两天，我相信这不会影响我的工作效率，希望您能考虑。
en: I'd like to formally request to work from home two days a week. I'm confident it won't affect my output, and I'd appreciate your consideration.
alt: I'm writing to formally ask about working from home two days a week. I'm sure it won't impact my productivity, and I'd be grateful if you'd consider it.
point: 正式申请说 I'd like to formally request，比 I want 得体

zh: 考虑到项目范围扩大了，我们建议把交付日期顺延两周，不知贵方能否接受？
en: Given that the scope has grown, we'd propose moving the delivery date back by two weeks. Would that be acceptable on your end?
alt: As the scope has expanded, we'd suggest pushing delivery back two weeks. Would that work for you?
point: 对客户正式提议用 we'd propose + -ing；“贵方”说 on your end

zh: 感谢您的信任，但以我目前的工作量，恐怕没法再接手这个项目，否则两边都做不好。
en: I appreciate your confidence in me, but with my current workload, I'm afraid I couldn't take this on without both projects suffering.
alt: Thank you for thinking of me, but given my current workload, I don't think I could take this on without both pieces of work suffering.
point: 正式婉拒：I'm afraid I couldn't… without…；“接手”是 take on

zh: 我们的系统从周一起间歇性宕机，恳请贵公司尽快派工程师排查，并告知预计修复时间。
en: Our system has been going down intermittently since Monday. We'd be grateful if you could send an engineer to investigate and give us an estimated fix time.
alt: We've had intermittent outages since Monday. Could you please send an engineer to look into it and let us know when you expect it to be resolved?
point: 正式请求用 We'd be grateful if you could…；“宕机”说 going down

zh: 我提议下个季度把服务器迁到云上，以降低维护成本，我可以先准备一份方案。
en: I'd like to propose migrating our servers to the cloud next quarter to cut maintenance costs, and I'd be happy to put together a business case.
alt: I'd suggest we move our servers to the cloud next quarter to reduce maintenance costs. I'm happy to draft a proposal.
point: I'd like to propose + -ing；“做方案”说 put together

zh: 麻烦您批准我访问财务系统的权限，我需要为月底审计准备数据，截止日期是本周五。
en: Could you please approve my access to the finance system? I need to prepare data for the month-end audit, which is due this Friday.
alt: I'd appreciate it if you could grant me access to the finance system, as I need to pull data for the month-end audit by Friday.
point: “批准权限”说 approve / grant access；非限定从句 which is due…

zh: 如果有机会的话，我希望入职后能参加一些项目管理培训，以便在团队里承担更多责任。
en: If the opportunity arose, I'd welcome the chance to do some project management training so I could take on more responsibility within the team.
alt: Given the opportunity, I'd be keen to complete some project management training so I could take on a bigger role in the team.
point: 面试中表达意愿：I'd welcome the chance to…；If the opportunity arose

zh: 感谢您发来录用通知。根据我的经验和市场行情，想请问起薪能否调到九万五左右。
en: Thank you for the offer. Based on my experience and the current market, I was wondering whether there's scope to bring the starting salary closer to ninety-five thousand.
alt: Thanks very much for the offer. Given my experience and current market rates, would you be open to a starting salary of around ninety-five thousand?
point: 谈薪说 whether there's scope to…；不要直说 I want more money

zh: 我写信是想正式提出辞职，最后工作日为下月十五日，交接方面我会全力配合。
en: I'm writing to formally give notice of my resignation, with my last day being the fifteenth of next month. I'll do everything I can to ensure a smooth handover.
alt: Please accept this as formal notice of my resignation. My last day will be the fifteenth of next month, and I'll make sure the handover goes smoothly.
point: 辞职信说 give notice of my resignation；“交接”是 handover

zh: 我想咨询一下，能否根据我在中国的学历申请学分认定？如有需要，我可以提供成绩单翻译件。
en: I'd like to enquire whether I could apply for credit based on my previous study in China. I'm happy to provide translated transcripts if required.
alt: Could you advise whether my previous study in China might count towards credit? I can supply translated transcripts if needed.
point: 正式询问用 I'd like to enquire whether…；“学分认定”说 apply for credit

zh: 如果您方便的话，我想约个时间跟您谈谈我的论文成绩，部分评语我不太理解。
en: If it's convenient, I'd appreciate the chance to meet and discuss my essay grade, as I'm unclear about some of the feedback.
alt: Would you have time to meet and go over my essay grade? I'm not quite sure I understand some of the comments.
point: If it's convenient 开头；“我不太理解”正式说 I'm unclear about

zh: 由于身体原因，我不得不退出本学期的课程，请问是否可以退还部分学费？
en: Due to health reasons, I need to withdraw from this semester's course. Could you please advise whether a partial refund of fees would be possible?
alt: For health reasons, I have to withdraw from my course this semester. Would I be eligible for a partial refund of my fees?
point: Could you please advise whether…；“退课”是 withdraw from

zh: 请问贵公司能否在我们搬出前做一次全屋深度清洁？如果可以，请发一份报价给我们。
en: Would your company be able to carry out a full deep clean before we move out? If so, could you please send us a quote?
alt: We're looking for a full deep clean before we move out. Is this something you could do, and could you send a quote?
point: 正式询价：Would your company be able to carry out…；If so 承上

zh: 我想建议把小区的公用垃圾桶移到车库旁边，这样既方便住户，也能减少异味。
en: I'd like to suggest relocating the shared bins next to the garages, which would be more convenient for residents and help reduce odours.
alt: May I suggest moving the shared bins beside the garages? It would be easier for residents and cut down on smells.
point: I'd like to suggest + -ing；odour 是英式拼写

zh: 谢谢您的介绍，但我们目前没有装太阳能板的打算，如果以后有需要，会主动联系您。
en: Thanks for explaining, but we're not looking at solar panels at the moment. If that changes, we'll be sure to get in touch.
alt: Thank you for the information, but solar isn't something we're considering right now. We'll contact you if that changes.
point: 婉拒推销说 we're not looking at… at the moment；“联系”是 get in touch

zh: 热水器已经坏了五天，恳请您尽快安排维修，也希望能就这段时间的不便商量一下适当减租。
en: As the hot water cylinder has been broken for five days, we'd ask that you arrange repairs urgently. We'd also welcome a discussion about a partial rent reduction.
alt: The hot water's been out for five days, so we'd appreciate urgent repairs, and we'd like to talk about a rent reduction for this period.
point: 正式请求用 we'd ask that you + 动词原形；“减租”说 rent reduction

zh: 我们一直按时交租，也很爱护房子，不知您是否愿意重新考虑这次的涨租幅度？
en: We've always paid on time and looked after the property, so we were hoping you might be willing to reconsider the size of the rent increase.
alt: Given that we've always paid on time and taken good care of the house, would you consider a smaller rent increase?
point: 谈判先摆事实，再说 we were hoping you might be willing to…

zh: 我想正式申请让一位新室友搬进来，她工作稳定，也可以提供推荐人供您审核。
en: I'd like to formally request your approval for a new flatmate to move in. She's in stable employment and can provide references for you to review.
alt: I'm writing to ask whether a new flatmate could move in. She has a steady job and is happy to supply references.
point: request your approval for… 是正式申请的说法

zh: 我们打算重建两家之间的篱笆，附上了两份报价，不知您是否有兴趣分担费用？期待您的回复。
en: We're looking to replace the boundary fence and have attached two quotes. Would you be interested in sharing the cost? We look forward to hearing from you.
alt: We'd like to replace the fence between our properties and have included two quotes. Would you be willing to split the cost? We'd love to hear your thoughts.
point: Would you be interested in + -ing；信尾 We look forward to…

zh: 我们理解偶尔聚会在所难免，但最近几乎每晚都闹到很晚，恳请您晚上十点后注意音量。
en: We understand the occasional party is unavoidable, but it's been very loud late at night most evenings recently. We'd kindly ask that you keep the volume down after ten.
alt: We appreciate that the odd party happens, but the noise has been going late most nights lately. Could you please keep it down after ten?
point: 先表示理解，再说 We'd kindly ask that you…

zh: 作为社区居民协会的成员，我想提议在公园里增设一些长椅，方便老人休息。
en: As a member of the residents' association, I'd like to put forward a proposal to install more benches in the park for older residents.
alt: As part of the residents' association, I'd like to propose adding more seating in the park for our older residents.
point: 正式提议说 put forward a proposal to…；“老人”说 older residents

zh: 过去一个月我家网速一直远低于套餐承诺的标准，希望贵公司调查原因，并考虑给予相应补偿。
en: For the past month, our broadband speed has been well below what our plan promises. I'd ask that you investigate the cause and consider an appropriate credit.
alt: Our internet speeds have been far below the advertised level for a month now. Could you please look into this and consider crediting our account?
point: 账单上的“补偿”说 a credit；I'd ask that you…

zh: 我认为这张账单可能有误，那段时间我们在国外，用水量不可能这么高，烦请重新核查。
en: I believe there may be an error on this bill, as we were overseas for that whole period. Could you please look into it again?
alt: I think this bill may be incorrect, since we were away overseas at the time. Would you mind reviewing it?
point: 委婉指错：I believe there may be an error

zh: 我最近失业了，想问一下能不能申请一个付款计划，把欠费分几个月还清。
en: As I've recently lost my job, I'd like to ask whether it would be possible to set up a payment plan to clear the balance over several months.
alt: I've recently been made redundant. Would you be able to put me on a payment plan so I can pay off the balance over a few months?
point: 正式提问用 I'd like to ask whether it would be possible to…

zh: 工程已经比合同约定的完工日期晚了三周，请您书面确认新的完工时间，并说明延误原因。
en: The work is now three weeks past the agreed completion date. Could you please confirm a new finish date in writing and explain the reason for the delay?
alt: We're now three weeks beyond the agreed completion date. I'd appreciate written confirmation of a new date and an explanation for the delay.
point: 正式要求 Could you please confirm… in writing

zh: 我们另外收到的两份报价都低不少，请问贵公司的价格有没有调整空间？可以的话我们很愿意选你们。
en: We've received two other quotes that are noticeably lower. Is there any room to adjust your price? If so, we'd be keen to go with you.
alt: The other two quotes we've had are quite a bit cheaper. Would you be able to sharpen your price? We'd prefer to use you if possible.
point: 压价正式说 Is there any room to adjust…；“选你们”说 go with you

zh: 很遗憾，新装的淋浴间仍然漏水，希望贵公司本周内派人返工，不另收费。
en: Unfortunately, the new shower is still leaking after installation. I'd appreciate it if you could send someone back this week to fix it at no extra cost.
alt: I'm sorry to say the shower you installed is still leaking. Could you please send someone this week to put it right free of charge?
point: I'd appreciate it if you could…；“不另收费”说 at no extra cost

zh: 我订的沙发到货时有明显划痕，附上照片，请贵公司安排换货或部分退款。
en: The couch I ordered arrived with noticeable scratches. I've attached photos and would ask that you arrange either a replacement or a partial refund.
alt: My sofa was delivered with visible scratches. Please see the attached photos. I'd like either a replacement or a partial refund.
point: 给对方两个选项：either a replacement or a partial refund

zh: 我在另一家店看到同款电视便宜两百块，请问贵店是否愿意按那个价格卖给我？
en: I've seen the same TV for two hundred dollars less at another store. Would you be willing to match that price?
alt: Another shop has this exact TV for two hundred dollars cheaper. Could you price match it?
point: “按那个价卖”说 match that price；Would you be willing to…

zh: 谢谢您的推荐，但延长保修我暂时就不买了，如果之后改变主意，我再联系您。
en: Thank you, but I'll decline the extended warranty for now. Should I change my mind, I'll be in touch.
alt: Thanks, but I won't take the extended warranty at this stage. If I change my mind, I'll let you know.
point: 正式拒绝说 I'll decline…；Should I… 倒装表示“如果”

zh: 我们想在下月十号预订贵店的包间办年终聚餐，大约三十人，能否发一下套餐菜单和价格？
en: We'd like to book your function room on the tenth of next month for our end-of-year dinner, about thirty people. Could you send through set menus and pricing?
alt: We're hoping to hold our work end-of-year dinner in your function room on the tenth of next month, for around thirty. Could you send us menu options and prices?
point: “发过来”说 send through；“包间”办活动叫 function room

zh: 昨晚我们在贵店用餐，主菜等了一个多小时，也没人解释原因，希望你们能重视这个问题。
en: We dined with you last night and waited over an hour for our mains without any explanation. I'd hope this is something you'll look into.
